Checklist item: All staff complete ransomware and phishing awareness training
Staff know how to report a suspicious email or locked computer immediately
Spam and malicious-attachment filtering is enabled
Every account uses a unique strong password
Multi-factor authentication is enabled for email cloud accounts and remote access
Operating systems browsers and business software receive security updates
Antivirus or endpoint protection is installed and active
Remote-access tools are not exposed to the internet without MFA and allowlisting
Important data has at least three copies
Backups use two different storage types or platforms
One backup copy is offline or immutable
Backup restoration is tested using a non-production file or system
Backup accounts are protected by MFA and separate credentials
Critical systems and recovery order are documented
Emergency contacts for IT support insurer and authorities are documented
Paper or offline copies of the recovery plan are available
Staff know to disconnect suspect devices from the network but not destroy evidence
A simple incident log template is available
Cloud and software vendors provide export or backup options
Data-protection and breach-notification obligations are reviewed with a qualified adviser
